title: Signature 51 · Muscle Hourglass · Alebrije · Cream Studio
prompt:
Subject: ONE Black woman in her late 30s, long voluminous curls with colorful beaded combs.

Physique: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, her face the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat. Muscular hourglass BBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 300 pounds — a gigantic heavy bust, broad rounded strong shoulders, enormous thick arms with big defined biceps, a clearly cinched waist that is narrow only in contrast to the enormous bust and the very wide heavy hips, a firm flat stomach with no visible abs, colossal thighs with powerful defined quads, massive calves. Feminine face, warm smile, not masculine, no bodybuilder look, dominating the frame.

Body Art: Full body Oaxacan alebrije painting painted directly on bare skin, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception. A glossy deep cobalt blue base densely painted in vivid hand-painted patterns of magenta, sunflower yellow, lime green, turquoise, and orange — tiny dots, fine stripes, zigzags, and small flowers packed edge to edge, the patterns fading softly at the wrists and ankles. The flowing bands of pattern wrap the swell of the biceps and quads and narrow across the cinched waistline. Purely decorative patterns, no animal figures. Densely filled with no plain skin, covering the shoulders and arms completely down to the wrists and the legs down to the ankles.

Pose: Standing in a glamour pose, wide stance with a strong hip shift, arms hanging relaxed slightly away from the body, no flexing.

Footwear: Extremely high magenta lacquer platform stiletto mules. Nails: extra long almond, turquoise with yellow dots.

Background & Lighting: A seamless warm cream studio backdrop with no props, the background much lighter than her body, soft warm light from one side carving the inward curve of the waist and the swell of the biceps and quads, making the vivid colors pop, bright highlights on every glossy curve. Extreme high-gloss painted finish. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
